id.description: Scenario ID; must match its file path (<dir>/<name>.json).

op.description: PascalCase JSON-RPC method (spec §5.3) executed through the SDK's native API, or a conformance pseudo-op: ResolveCard (fetch well-known card), SelectInterface (resolve card + report which interface the SDK selects), RawRequest (POST rawBody verbatim, bypassing the SDK — used only to probe server envelope handling).

params.description: Literal JSON-RPC params for the op (wire format, camelCase).

rawBody.description: For op=RawRequest only: the literal HTTP body to POST.

server.description: Scripted server behavior for this scenario. Omit for RawRequest scenarios (the server SDK's envelope layer is the system under test).

respond.description: Literal result object (wire format) the scripted handler returns for the scenario's op.

error.description: Protocol error the scripted handler raises instead of responding.

sse.description: Ordered StreamResponse payloads (wire format) for streaming ops.

card.description: Agent card (wire format) served at /.well-known/agent-card.json while this scenario is selected. Interface URLs use the placeholder {{baseUrl}}, substituted by the harness.

rawResult.description: Escape hatch: literal JSON text the harness injects as the result without going through SDK types. Used only by edge/ scenarios that must emit wire shapes SDK types cannot express (e.g. unknown fields). Harnesses that cannot inject raw results report skip.

checks.description: Evaluated by the runner against the harness-normalized outcome (the SDK-decoded value re-encoded to wire JSON — so lenient/strict decode behavior is what is tested).

streamOrder.description: Exact ordered list of event kinds the client must observe before stream end.

expectRequest.description: Checks the runner evaluates against the captured wire request body (from the capture proxy) — used to verify what the client SDK actually sent, e.g. tenant echoing.

appliesTo.description: Restrict the scenario to specific implementations; cells outside the selection report n/a, not fail.

equals.description: Value at path must deep-equal this.

count.description: Value at path must be an array of exactly this length.

contains.description: Value at path must be a string containing this substring.
